name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the murder of Mehdi Kessaci in Marseille and calls for stronger EU action against drug trafficking. It asks for more police and judicial resources, better port security, and measures against criminal money and online recruitment. It also wants victims' families and local groups involved in drug policy, and warns that planned cuts to regional funding could harm poor neighbourhoods.

- The EU is asked to boost police, customs and judicial cooperation and port security; this affects law enforcement, port workers and fishers.
- It asks for seized criminal assets to fund social projects and for victims' families to help shape drug policy.
- It is an opinion; the Commission and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
